news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.19 (vs ₹0.072 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.19 (up from ₹0.072 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹132.3m (up 109% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.99m (up ₹4.16m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 2.3% (up from net loss in FY 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 3% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 12% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
